text: dsh-restart 是一款面向 DSH Web 的重启命令插件，通过注册 /dsh-restart 命令，为 Harness 安排延迟重启。它会根据当前进程所在的 systemd 服务单元或运行环境，选择重启服务，或启动一个等待旧进程退出后接替运行的新进程。用户可以设置重启模式、服务单元名称、响应送达延迟、后继进程输出方式和命令语言，也可在命令参数中指定 1 至 60 秒的延迟。插件还提供 DSH 插件设置页来编辑这些选项。适合需要在浏览器收到命令回复后重启 DSH Web 的场景；不需要 API 密钥或外部账号，但需要进程具有相应的重启条件。

dsh-restart adds /dsh-restart to DSH Web for delayed Harness restarts. It detects a systemd service to restart or starts a successor process after the old one exits. Configure mode, unit, delay, output, and command language in the plugin settings. No API key or external account is required.
想让 DSH Web 在回复送达后自动重启。
DSH 进程更新配置后，怎么安排它延迟重启？
How can I schedule a delayed restart of my DSH Web process?
dsh-restart 的功能「延迟重启 Harness」：输入 /dsh-restart 并可附带 1 至 60 秒的等待时间；插件按自动检测、systemd 单元或后继进程模式安排重启，并在完成后让浏览器重新连接。
dsh-restart 的功能「重启设置页」：在 DSH 插件设置页编辑命令语言、重启模式、systemd 单元、响应延迟和后继进程输出方式，并保存配置。
dsh-restart 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 43 天；提交数 9；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。
dsh-restart 提供设置项 language：en
dsh-restart 提供设置项 delaySeconds
dsh-restart 提供设置项 unit
dsh-restart 提供设置项 mode：auto
dsh-restart 提供设置项 execStdio：inherit

dsh-restart README · dsh-restart：Adds `/dsh-restart` to DSH Web. It schedules a restart of the current Harness process or its own systemd user service after a short delay, allowing the command response to reach the browser.

dsh-restart README · Install：Install the latest tagged GitHub release:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'https://github.com/yoggu/dsh-restart.git#v0.1.3'
```

Or download the source and link the local checkout:

```sh
git clone --branch v0.1.3 --depth 1 https://github.com/yoggu/dsh-restart.git
cd dsh-restart
dsh plugin --profile web add "link:$(pwd)"
```

Keep a linked checkout in place while the plugin is installed. Use the profile you actually run if it is not `web`.

dsh-restart README · Install：Restart DSH Web if necessary to load the command. No credentials are required, but the DSH process must be allowed to restart itself or schedule a systemd user timer.

To uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-restart`.

dsh-restart README · Usage：```text
/dsh-restart       # configured delay (default: 1 second)
/dsh-restart 10    # restart in 10 seconds
```

The **Plugins → Restart** page configures `mode` (`auto`, `unit`, `exec`), systemd `unit`, `delaySeconds` (1–60), and `execStdio`. `auto` uses its own systemd unit when detected, otherwise starts a successor process. The running turn is interrupted and the web page reconnects afterward. Only trusted users with access to the DSH command surface should be able to invoke it.

dsh-restart README · Language and tests：Settings are in English. Command descriptions and responses default to **English**; set the plugin's **Command language** to **Deutsch** (`language: de`) to preserve the previous German command wording. This setting is independent of the Harness global UI language; unset or unsupported values fall back to English. Responses read the live setting; the menu description is selected when the command mounts.
dsh-restart README · Language and tests：Run `npm test` after installing peer dependencies. Tests mock process spawning, cgroup reads, and exit timers; they never call systemd or restart a process.
